g.title: FlashGuard
g.text: Arduino UNO Q · two Edge Impulse models + a heart-rate check · everything on the board, offline
The LED matrix always shows the current state with static icons (nothing on the device flashes) · every alert is logged to events.csv

g.text: ≥ 0.6 for 5 s in the watch window
